fieldNotes.truckGate: Confirmed gated truck entrance off Fitzgerald Road: 2019-06 Street View shows a swing/cantilever gate across the drive with ENTRANCE and warning signage; the entrance lane crosses a rail spur.
fieldNotes.guardShack: A small light-colored guard-booth structure sits beside the entrance lane just inside the gate (visible left of the lane in multiple Street View headings). Workers in safety vests present at the gate.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale clearly identified in imagery; left false (low confidence) - distilleries often weigh inbound grain but no weigh pad resolved here.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Loading docks on the production/bottling building - z19/z20 imagery shows tankers and trailers backed into a dock bank; estimated ~14 doors, band 10-25, medium confidence.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Long row of ~20+ parked trailers in the central lot plus additional trailers staged along Fitzgerald Road; band 25-50.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Dedicated trailer-storage rows present both in the central campus lot and along the Fitzgerald Road frontage.
fieldNotes.railServed: An active rail spur runs into the property and past the truck gate, visible in z19-z21 satellite and Street View.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Campus: historic distillery / visitor center, production-bottling building, and ~18 multi-story brick rickhouses.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Wide paved internal yard between the gate and the production docks provides interior queuing room.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Inside the Louisville metro (Shively), surrounded by dense industrial fabric - Urban.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Internal yard depth from the gate to the production docks easily holds 3+ trucks.
